name: daknoadmin
description:
DaknoAdmin for ChatGPT gives you quick and easy access to your real estate CRM through natural conversation. Stay organized, understand your leads, and keep relationships moving forward, all directly in ChatGPT.
- Access contact details and see when leads were last contacted or active on your website.
- Get insights into a lead's property interests and activity to help personalize your follow-up.
- Add new contacts and save notes from your conversations.
- Create follow-up to-dos to keep track of your next steps.
- Update contact statuses and manage tags to keep your database organized.

Connect with your existing DaknoAdmin account to get started. ChatGPT can only access the contacts available to your DaknoAdmin user.

defaultPrompt: When did I last contact [name], and have they visited my website recently?
Add a note to [name] and remind me to call them Friday at 10am
Tag [name] as Buyer and change their status to Pursue

positive.description: Agent checks when they last reached out to a lead and whether the lead has been active on their website.
positive.prompt: When did I last contact Sarah Miller, and has she been on my website recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Sarah Miller and says how long ago she was last contacted and when she last visited the website. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Agent saves what a lead said on a call and sets a reminder to call back.
positive.prompt: Add a note to Sarah Miller that she wants a 3 bedroom home near downtown, and remind me to call her Friday at 10am.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the note on Sarah Miller and creates a call to-do that is due the next Friday at 10:00 AM in the account's timezone, then confirms both.

positive.description: Agent marks a lead as a buyer and moves them up the pipeline.
positive.prompt: Tag Sarah Miller as Buyer and change her status to Pursue.
positive.tools_triggered: list_contacts, list_tags, then add_contact_tag and update_contact_status
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the existing Buyer tag to Sarah Miller and sets her status to Pursue, then confirms both.

positive.description: Agent cleans up a tag that no longer applies.
positive.prompt: Remove the Buyer tag from Sarah Miller.
positive.expected_behavior: Removes the Buyer tag from Sarah Miller and confirms. If she doesn't have it, says so and changes nothing.

positive.description: Agent adds a new lead they just met.
positive.prompt: Add Daniel Brooks as a new contact, phone 919-555-0142.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks whether Daniel Brooks already exists. If not, creates him with that phone number and confirms. If he already exists from an earlier run, ChatGPT says so and asks before adding a duplicate.

negative.description: Looks like a contact lookup but is a home search. DaknoAdmin manages contacts, not listing search. Expected: no DaknoAdmin tool is called; ChatGPT answers on its own (for example with web search) or says DaknoAdmin doesn't cover this.
negative.prompt: Find me 3 bedroom homes for sale near downtown Raleigh under $450,000.

negative.description: Area-level market question with no tool behind it. Expected: no DaknoAdmin tool is called; ChatGPT answers on its own (for example with web search) or says DaknoAdmin doesn't cover this.
negative.prompt: What are home prices doing in Raleigh this year?

negative.description: Writing task with no CRM record involved. Expected: no DaknoAdmin tool is called; ChatGPT writes the description on its own.
negative.prompt: Write a listing description for a 4 bedroom colonial with a renovated kitchen.

publication.release_notes:
Connect your DaknoAdmin account and start working with your real estate CRM:
- Look up a contact and see when they were last contacted and last active on your website
- Get a summary of a lead's property interests based on their website activity
- Add new contacts and save notes from your conversations
- Create call, text, email and follow-up to-dos with a due date and time
- Update contact statuses and add or remove existing tags

Requires a DaknoAdmin account.
